column1: # comment: "Epistemics slice alignments (Principle 5 \u2014 by reference only). AXIOMATIC GROUNDING: gmeow:DoxasticState is a gufo:Kind subclass of gmeow:MentalMoment, and gmeow:MentalMoment is itself a named gufo:Category under gufo:IntrinsicMode (kernel slice); this grounding is documented in the set comment rather than asserted as a mapping row. CRMinf: gmeow:DoxasticState aligns to I2_Belief; gmeow:Proposition to I4_Proposition_Set; gmeow:basesBeliefOn (the basing edge of the five-way justification split) aligns to crminf:J2_concluded_that. I5_Inference_Making is referenced in prose only as the related CRMinf inference-making act; SUMO: gmeow:believes and gmeow:knowsThat are related by reference to SUMO believes / knows, with an explicit note that GMEOW knowsThat is NON-FACTIVE. Wikidata: gmeow:Proposition \u2192 Q108163 (proposition). Q446151 and Q9081 from the issue did not match the intended concepts on entity-page inspection and are left unaligned. IAO: gmeow:Proposition is a relatedMatch to IAO information content entity (IAO_0000030). ATOMIC belief edges and AIF S-/RA-nodes are referenced in prose only; no stable, resolvable RDF namespace suitable for SSSOM rows is available. gmeow:claimModality is already aligned to crminf:J5_holds_to_be in the standpoint slice and is not duplicated here. gmeow:credence and gmeow:accepts have no canonical RDF vocabulary and are left unaligned. Epistemic-modal operators (KK/S4/S5/KD45) belong to the logic: slice profiles."

column6: gmeow:DoxasticState is an endurant mental moment (gufo:IntrinsicMode); crminf:I2_Belief is a temporal entity — close but not co-extensional
gmeow:Proposition is a single truth-apt content; crminf:I4_Proposition_Set is a set of such contents
gmeow:Proposition is a socially-constructed, truth-apt content; IAO_0000030 is the broader information content entity class
J2_concluded_that relates an inference-making act to the belief it concludes; gmeow:basesBeliefOn (the ground a belief is actually founded on) inverts the direction of support
SUMO believes is conceptually adjacent; GMEOW believes is non-factive, standpoint-indexed, and open-range. ATOMIC belief edges are referenced in prose only (no stable RDF namespace)
SUMO knows is typically factive; GMEOW knowsThat is explicitly non-factive — relatedMatch only. Wikidata Q9081 from the issue did not resolve to a relevant concept and is dropped
